purpose: Wave-4 CROSS-STACK planner rows that link already-filed single-region pieces into multi-region ironman skilling stacks. Complements progression-enrichment-regional-skilling-cross-chains-2026-07-26 (tool/supply chains) and wave4-critical-tools (missing equipment) without re-emitting finished single-item equipment rows. Targets GOTE+Dark Facet+ritual shard sustain, curly-roots FM ceiling, dual monolith relics, Fishing bait stacks, Imcando family, masterwork plate→Orthen pressure, elder Div path, auto-burn WC paths, Seren skilling prayers package, Fired Up adze chain, elite outfit core set, and crystal-rod waterfall+fury stack.

policy.region_rule: required_regions + region_requirement_type=all_required only when every listed region is a hard gate for the full stack. Use single when only one region is required. Never put multi-region/cross-region/global in region field values.
policy.stack_rule: These rows are edge/combo packages. Prefer links_existing_ids to the single-region equipment/activity rows; do not restate every sub-item as a new first-class unlock.
policy.no_trade_rule: Ironman permanent unlocks and self-sourced stack pieces. Tradeable intermediates stay pressure unless craft/shop is region-locked.
policy.rate_rule: No invented XP/hour. Unlock state, effects, multi-region pressure, and wiki-stated ceiling setups only.
policy.duplicate_guard: Do not re-emit asgarnia:inferno-adze equipment (wave4-critical-tools). This file owns cross-region:fired-up-inferno-adze-chain. Prefer existing anachronia:bait-and-switch-relic, kandarin:always-adze-relic / kandarin Always Adze tags, tirannwn:superheat-form, cross-region:grace-of-the-elves-porter-chain, cross-region:orthen-superheat-autoheater, and outfit equipment rows.

activity_additions.name: GOTE + Dark Facet of Grace + ancient elven ritual shard sustain
activity_additions.category: cross-region Seren prayer and porter sustain stack
requirements: Grace of the elves: 107 Invention alchemical onyx → 91 Crafting alchemical onyx necklace → 87 Magic Lvl-6 Enchant
Dark Facet of Grace: imbue enchantment on GOTE (permanent account upgrade for the player who imbues)
Dark Facet craft: dark onyx core + 7 Seren components + 10 onyx + 5 crystal tool seeds at 85 Invention (combine on dark onyx core)

Dark onyx core self-source: very rare Wilderness activity rewards (black salamanders, Wilderness Agility Course lap, Wilderness bloodwood fell, Wilderness herb patch harvest, Mandrith/Wilderness Slayer chest path)
Ancient elven ritual shard: Lost Grove creatures (1/1,500 on task, 1/5,000 off) or Solak (1/1,000)
Seren skilling prayers from The Light Within on Ancient Curses (Light Form 80, Superheat Form 91, Chronicle Attraction 91)
unlocks: Base GOTE: halves Light Form / Superheat Form / Chronicle Attraction drain; 500 porter charges; Seren spirit RDT bank deposits while gathering; Max Guild skill-portal teleports when attuned
Dark Facet of Grace imbued: Seren skill-prayer drain reduction 50% → 100% (zero drain while GOTE worn); porter capacity 500 → 2,000
Ancient elven ritual shard: activate to restore 37.5% of max prayer points over 30s (5-minute cooldown, infinite uses)
Wiki sustain pattern: GOTE + ritual shard fully supports Superheat Form and Chronicle Attraction; Light Form still needs renewals/prayer gear or Dark Facet zero-drain
With Dark Facet, Seren skill prayers cost zero prayer while GOTE is worn — ritual shard becomes optional combat/AFK buffer rather than required sustain
region_pressure: Tirannwn: Seren prayer unlock (The Light Within), Max Guild portal attunement, crystal tool seeds / Seren components pressure, Lost Grove + Solak ritual-shard self-source, GOTE Seren-spirit gathering value.
Forinthry: dark onyx core is hard Wilderness / Forinthry geography — without it ironmen cannot self-craft Dark Facet of Grace.
Asgarnia optional: Invention Guild manufacture of alchemical onyx and Dark Facet Invention step.
Porter energy tiers remain multi-colony pressure (Desert luminous VI, Morytania radiant V, Kandarin vibrant IV, Tirannwn incandescent VII) — optional unless modelling full self-charge.
activity_additions.notes: Stack combo above cross-region:grace-of-the-elves-porter-chain. GOTE alone is not zero-drain; Dark Facet is the permanent upgrade; ritual shard is the rechargeable sustain piece when facet is missing or for Light Form. Do not invent dark-core rates. Prefer existing GOTE porter-chain row for energy geography; this row is the prayer-sustain edge.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Hard Tirannwn for Seren prayers + ritual-shard geography + GOTE value pair. Hard Forinthry for dark onyx core self-source. Invention manufacture is global (not a hard Asgarnia gate).

activity_additions.name: Curly roots Firemaking ceiling stack (Jadinko + All Fired Up gear)
activity_additions.category: cross-region Firemaking and Woodcutting method stack
requirements: 83+ Woodcutting and 83+ Firemaking for curly roots in the Jadinko Lair (south-eastern Karamja)
Ring of fire (All Fired Up beacon rewards — 6 beacons lit)
Flame gloves (All Fired Up — 10 beacons lit; 79 Firemaking to equip)

Optional ceiling amplifiers: Nature's sentinel outfit (full set success/nest bonuses + optional auto-burn toggle), Superheat Form (91 Prayer, The Light Within), Always Adze relic, Inferno adze incineration
Jadinko Lair access / favour loop for baseline root chopping into lair firepits
unlocks: Baseline ironman high-end free FM: chop curly roots, burn in Jadinko Lair firepits with Ring of fire + Flame gloves
Wiki ironman framing: Nature's sentinel + Ring of fire quotes the practical mid-ceiling; Flame gloves stack on the FM XP side
Superheat Form or Always Adze auto-burn roots while chopping (no separate firepit step) — Superheat is Tirannwn prayer pressure; Always Adze is monolith alternative without prayer drain
Inferno adze incineration works on curly roots and is boosted by flame gloves + ring of fire on the FM side
Do not invent XP/hour figures in planner rows — treat as method unlock stack, not rate table
region_pressure: Karamja hard: Jadinko Lair is the curly-roots method site (see karamja:jadinko-lair-curly-roots).
Asgarnia hard: Ring of fire + Flame gloves are All Fired Up permanent FM XP gear (asgarnia:ring-of-fire / asgarnia:flame-gloves / asgarnia:all-fired-up-beacons).
Tirannwn optional ceiling: Superheat Form for auto-burn while chopping (and GOTE / Dark Facet sustain).
Anachronia optional: Always Adze or Orthen furnace core when Superheat is the prayer path.
activity_additions.notes: Training-gap firemaking:curly-roots-baseline is Karamja-only; firemaking:curly-roots-superheat-form-ceiling adds Tirannwn. This stack models the hard two-region gear+site pair planners miss when only filing Jadinko Lair or only filing All Fired Up rewards. Superheat/Always Adze remain optional ceiling partners, not required_regions here.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Require Karamja method site + Asgarnia AFU gear for the classic ironman curly-roots gear stack. Score Tirannwn only when planning Superheat Form auto-burn ceiling.

activity_additions.name: Bait and Switch + Always Adze dual monolith skilling paths
requirements: Bait and Switch: 99 Archaeology (boostable path for death mask), Orthen Dig Site death mask, catspeak amulet / cramulet to speak with Bob the cat → Evil Bob's Catspaw → harness at mysterious monolith (2,000 chronotes + 100 monolith energy)

Always Adze: 83 Archaeology (boostable), inactive Seed of the Charyou Tree from Thalmund's Forge / Into the Forge (Warforge), activate seed while wearing flame gloves (79 Firemaking), harness at monolith (2,000 chronotes + 100 monolith energy)
Both relics cost 100 monolith energy while harnessed — plan monolith budget when dual-pathing
Kandarin Deep Sea Fishing hub is the primary high-volume Fishing payoff for Bait and Switch dual Fishing+Cooking
unlocks: Bait and Switch: cookable fish auto-cook on catch at 50% Cooking XP, never burn, any Cooking level; porters transport cooked fish after cook; works with shark outfit consume-all (still consumes fish); extra Fury shark catch cooks without extra Cooking XP
Bait exclusions: Arc fish, divine locations, Daemonheim vile fish, uncookable catches (crystal urchins)

Always Adze: logs cut while Woodcutting auto-burn for full Firemaking XP with no prayer drain; also burns curly roots and timber fungus (documented exclusions: divine locations, BGH jungle logs, bloodwood, Arc bamboo, ivy, Daemonheim logs)
Dual-path planner meaning: permanent dual-skill gatherer relics for Fishing/Cooking and Woodcutting/Firemaking without competing for the same method site
region_pressure: Anachronia hard: Orthen death mask self-source for Bait and Switch.

Kandarin hard for this dual-path package: Deep Sea Fishing hub is the self-sufficient high-volume Bait and Switch fishing geography and a primary dual-skill training hub planners pair with Always Adze WC routes.
Karamja optional: Warforge / Thalmund's Forge seed geography for Always Adze (other enrichment files tag the seed under Karamja or Anachronia planning — keep as seed-site pressure).
Asgarnia optional: flame gloves to activate the inactive seed (All Fired Up).
activity_additions.notes: Links anachronia:bait-and-switch-relic and Always Adze rows into one dual-path edge so region pickers surface both gatherer relics together. Do not claim Always Adze seed is Kandarin-owned — Kandarin is the method/payoff half of the dual package in this stack. Flame gloves remain Asgarnia support for seed activation.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Require Anachronia for Bait and Switch. Require Kandarin when scoring the dual-path Fishing hub half. Tag Karamja if League maps Warforge seed exclusively there; tag Asgarnia when flame gloves are not auto-completed.

Anachronia hard: Bait and Switch unlock (anachronia:bait-and-switch-relic).

unlocks: Family of Imcando-tier gather tools feeding tier-90 crystal fusions and later tier-100 Ramarno upgrades
Imcando pickaxe → crystal pickaxe / Earth and Song mining chain
Imcando hatchet → crystal hatchet / Ember and Glade woodcutting chain

Inferno adze and Nature's sentinel are partial-burn bridges before either permanent 100% path

Kandarin hard for this dual-path package: primary multi-skill WC method geography planners pair with Always Adze / partial burn for dual XP (idols, hub trees, Deep Sea-adjacent loops).
